summary: Completed comprehensive testing of PolarizadosYA! automotive service management system v2.0. All features working correctly: role-based login, menu filtering, Check-in with QR, Assign page, Technician view, and Billing/Delivery flow.

issues: Accessibility: Missing aria-describedby for dialogs (minor - existing from previous iteration)

passed_tests: Backend: All 16 workflow tests passed (100%)
Backend: Login for all 5 roles (admin, asesor, coordinador, tecnico, facturacion)
Backend: Check-in endpoint returns order by code
Backend: Ingreso approval with signature, cedula, services
Backend: Order history tracking endpoint
Backend: Role-based access control (403 for unauthorized actions)
Backend: Full workflow from agendado to servicio_completado
Frontend: Admin login shows all menu items (8 items)
Frontend: Asesor sees correct menu items (Dashboard, Agendamiento, Check-in, Vehículos, Revisión 360, Cotizaciones, Órdenes)
Frontend: Coordinador sees correct menu items (Dashboard, Vehículos, Asignar Técnico, Órdenes)
Frontend: Tecnico sees correct menu items (Dashboard, Mis Servicios)
Frontend: Facturacion sees correct menu items (Dashboard, Facturación, Órdenes)
Frontend: Check-in page loads with QR scanner and code entry tabs
Frontend: Check-in search finds order and displays QR code
Frontend: Check-in Step 2 shows services, cedula, signature pad, photo buttons
Frontend: Assign page loads for coordinador (empty state when no orders in 'en_revision')
Frontend: Technician page loads with correct empty state message
Frontend: Billing page displays orders in 'servicio_completado' status
Frontend: Payment dialog with all payment methods (Efectivo, Tarjeta, Nequi, etc.)
Frontend: Theme toggle works (dark/light mode)
seed_data_creation: Users created via /api/seed/users endpoint. Test orders created during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core workflow features tested and working. The application implements a complete automotive service management flow: Agendamiento -> Check-in/Ingreso (with QR, signature, cedula) -> Revisión 360 -> Asignar Técnico -> Mis Servicios (technician) -> Facturación/Entrega. Role-based access control is properly implemented. Test orders created with prefix 'TEST_' can be identified and cleaned up if needed.
